title: Contract Expiration Caused by Poor Planning
request_text: The City's janitorial contract expires Friday. Facilities did not complete the replacement solicitation in time, and no new contract is ready for award. Janitorial services are required at City Hall, the police station, and public restrooms. The department requests an emergency six-month contract with the incumbent vendor to prevent an interruption in service.

available_documents.summary: Shows the contract expiration date this Friday.
